body.text: Published 7e513341 non-force. CI exposed that its Atlas index contains mixed worktree records (204/70) while committed YaFF exports 185/39. A hook re-exported live state during repair; concurrent unpushed commits 30504c6b and 70a6dfd0 now block a safe repair push. Do not push them without owner classification.

subject: Bounded promotion CI repair blocked by concurrent history
